{"relevant": true, "severity": "critical", "message": "internal/media/avatar.go (POST /avatar): saving under ./uploads with the client-provided filename allows path traversal (e.g. `../../etc/cron.d/x` or `../main.go`) and overwriting other users' files. Fix: discard the client name; generate a random name (uuid) and use `filepath.Base` only for extension lookup. Derive the extension from the sniffed type, not the client's. Also: (1) wrap the body in `http.MaxBytesReader` to cap size (e.g. 2MB) to prevent disk/memory exhaustion; (2) validate content with `http.DetectContentType` against an allowlist (png/jpeg/webp) and reject SVG/HTML, which enable stored XSS if served from your origin; (3) require authentication and bind the file to the session user, never a user ID from the form; (4) serve uploads with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and ideally from a separate domain or non-executable directory; create files with 0600/0644 permissions and open with `O_EXCL`."}
